title: Release quest-cli 0.4.0
description: Orchestrator-ruled (opum-agent, 2026-09-07) to carry QCLI-229 (task pause/start, demote --to -- a CLI contract change past the 0.3.x patch series) and everything else dev holds over main into a git tag. Follows docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md and the QCLI-238 (0.3.4) precedent exactly.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Root package.json, QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, optionalDependencies, and the conformance fixture bumped to 0.4.0 and committed together with freshly-built (Bun 1.3.14) platform packages, bun.lock regenerated in the same commit
dev promoted to main (fast-forward, required checks green on the exact SHA)
v0.4.0 tag pushed and prepublication-qualification.yml dispatched against it; native-execution receipt downloaded and bun run receipt:require passes
release.yml dispatched with publish=false (dry run) then publish=true against v0.4.0, gated on the receipt -- publish=true is the one step requiring the repos own users direct, immediate go-ahead
Post-publish clean-install smoke passes against the published registry artifacts, including task pause/start and demote --to end to end
bun run receipt:verify-published passes against the six published platform tarballs
docs/reference/quest-cli-release-truth.md gets a new dated section for 0.4.0
.claude-plugin/plugin.json version matches 0.4.0; report the exact tag and commit SHA to opum-agent once published so the opum-quest marketplace entry can pin to it

plan: 1. Bump version across all hand-edited locations, rebuild six platform binaries locally with Bun 1.3.14, run check:packages/test:packages, regenerate bun.lock, commit to dev.
2. Promote dev to main (PR + fast-forward push) once checks are green on that SHA.
3. Tag v0.4.0, dispatch prepublication-qualification.yml against it, download and verify the native-execution receipt.
4. Ask the repo owner for explicit publish authorization (single AskUserQuestion), dry-run then publish release.yml.
5. Post-publish clean-install smoke, receipt:verify-published, release-truth doc entry, report tag/SHA/registry versions.
implementationNotes: 2026-09-07: opum-cli-e2e disclosed running 'QUEST_BUN_TARGET=darwin-arm64 bun run scripts/build-platform-packages.mjs' in this working tree ~30-60s before commit aba3b73 landed, raising doubt about whether the committed darwin-arm64 binary was theirs or mine. Verified functionally rather than by hash: Bun --compile is documented non-reproducible in this repo's own release runbook ('the same source at the same Bun version produces a different binary on a different machine... rebuild and compare is not available as a verification technique anywhere in this pipeline'), so a fresh rebuild-and-hash-diff would mismatch even against a legitimately clean commit and prove nothing either way. Instead extracted the actual committed binary from aba3b73 (git show aba3b73:npm/quest-darwin-arm64/bin/quest) and ran it directly: --version reports 0.4.0, and 'quest manifest --json' lists both 'task pause' and 'task start' with 'task demote' carrying filters:['to'] -- QCLI-229's exact additions. A binary built from any pre-0.4.0/pre-QCLI-229 dev state (which is necessarily what opum-cli-e2e's build would have been, since it ran before my version-bump commit existed) could not report these. This is conclusive: the committed darwin-arm64 binary is my build, not theirs. The other five platform binaries were never in question -- QUEST_BUN_TARGET scopes scripts/build-platform-packages.mjs to exactly the one requested platform (verified by reading the script), so opum-cli-e2e's darwin-arm64-only run could not have touched linux/win32 artifacts at all, and check:packages/test:packages validated all six together before this commit. All six committed binaries in aba3b73 stand as built.

Promotion, tag, and receipt complete. dev promoted to main via fast-forward push (git push origin dev:main), main now at 43441cc (verified via PR #285, all required checks -- source-gates, operating block digest -- green on that exact SHA before promotion). v0.4.0 tagged at 43441cc and pushed. prepublication-qualification.yml dispatched against the tag (run 34130538518): all 10 jobs (source-gates, operating block digest, all six platform targets, candidate-bundle, native-execution-receipt) completed success. Downloaded the native-execution-receipt artifact and gated it: "bun run receipt:require -- --receipt native-execution-receipt.json" -> "Native-execution receipt binds 0.4.0 at 43441cc across all six platforms."

Publish (release.yml --publish=true) remains on hold per orchestrator ruling (opum-agent, 2026-09-07): lore-cli found the shipped pausedStatus design breaks their reconcile path (LCLI-455), fixing as lore 0.4.6. Not dispatching publish=true, dry-run or otherwise, until that clears.

Publish authorized by the repo's own user (2026-09-07, AskUserQuestion: "Yes, publish now") after the orchestrator lifted the hold -- lore 0.4.6 confirmed independently on the registry (npm view @opum-ai/lore version -> 0.4.6, latest dist-tag) before asking.

Dry run (release.yml --ref v0.4.0 -f publish=false, run 34133338726): success. Verified it actually exercised npm publish --dry-run for all seven packages (log inspection, not just the green checkmark) -- each showed "(dry-run)" in its publish notice with correct 0.4.0 tarball contents.

Real publish (release.yml --ref v0.4.0 -f publish=true, run 34133947526): the Publish step itself succeeded for all seven packages (each printed npm's success marker and a signed provenance statement to the Sigstore transparency log). The workflow's own post-publish verification step failed after its 10x30s retry budget (5 min) because @opum-ai/quest-win32-arm64 specifically stayed in npm's async "being processed" provenance-indexing state longer than that -- its own publish log showed npm's "Your package is being processed and may take a few minutes to become available" notice. This was diagnosed as npm-side propagation, not a publish failure or a defect requiring a fix: the six other packages were visible within the retry window, and win32-arm64 resolved shortly after (confirmed independently via repeated `npm view` polling, no retry/re-publish of anything -- re-running the workflow would have been rejected by npm as a duplicate-version publish attempt).

Independently verified all seven packages post-resolution: quest, quest-darwin-arm64, quest-darwin-x64, quest-linux-arm64, quest-linux-x64, quest-win32-arm64, quest-win32-x64 all report version 0.4.0 via npm view.

Post-publish clean-install smoke (fresh scratch dir, npm install @opum-ai/quest@0.4.0 from the real registry, no local build involved): `quest --version` -> 0.4.0; `quest manifest --json` lists both "task pause" and "task start" with "task demote" carrying filters:["to"]; full lifecycle end-to-end against the installed binary -- init, task create, edit to In Progress, pause (-> Blocked), start (-> In Progress), demote --to "To Do" (-> To Do) -- all succeeded exactly as designed.

Receipt verification: `bun run receipt:verify-published -- 0.4.0 --receipt native-execution-receipt.json` -> "Receipt matches every platform package published as 0.4.0." Downloads all six published platform tarballs and compares each binary's digest to the qualification-run receipt; passed.

quest-cli 0.4.0 is fully released: main at 43441cc, tagged v0.4.0, all seven npm packages published and verified, native-execution receipt confirmed against what the registry actually serves.
finalSummary:
quest-cli 0.4.0 is fully released. Carries QCLI-229 (quest task pause/start, demote's required --to) and everything dev held since 0.3.4.

Version bumped and committed (PR #284, 43441cc): package.json, questPlatformPackages checksums, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, the conformance fixture, six freshly-built platform binaries (Bun 1.3.14), bun.lock, CLAUDE.md's managed block. dev promoted to main via fast-forward (PR #285, required checks green on the exact SHA). Tagged v0.4.0 at 43441cc. prepublication-qualification.yml passed all jobs against the tag; native-execution receipt verified locally before publish.

A sibling session (opum-cli-e2e) ran a scoped darwin-arm64 build in this working tree shortly before the version-bump commit; verified functionally (not by hash, since Bun --compile is documented non-reproducible here) that the committed binary was this session's own 0.4.0+QCLI-229 build, not the sibling's -- recorded on this task.

Publish held per orchestrator ruling: lore-cli found the new paused status broke their reconcile path (LCLI-455), fixed as lore 0.4.6. Hold lifted once lore 0.4.6 was confirmed independently on the registry. Dry run (release.yml publish=false) passed, verified by log inspection to have actually exercised npm publish --dry-run for all seven packages. The repository's own user authorized the real publish via AskUserQuestion. Real publish (release.yml publish=true) succeeded for all seven packages; the workflow's own post-publish verification step failed after its 5-minute retry budget because quest-win32-arm64 specifically stayed in npm's async provenance-processing state longer than that window -- diagnosed as npm-side propagation lag, not a publish failure (the Publish step itself succeeded, provenance was signed to the Sigstore transparency log, and the package resolved shortly after on independent polling; no republish was attempted).

Independently verified all seven packages report 0.4.0. Post-publish clean-install smoke against the real registry (fresh npm install @opum-ai/quest@0.4.0) proved the new lifecycle end to end: init, task create, edit to In Progress, pause (-> Blocked), start (-> In Progress), demote --to "To Do" (-> To Do). bun run receipt:verify-published confirmed the receipt matches every published platform package. docs/reference/quest-cli-release-truth.md carries a new dated 0.4.0 section with full shasum/integrity evidence.
